设计意图： Net volume-weighted directional movement is kept as primary mechanism; a lightweight ADX trend-strength gate attenuates the signal in non-trending markets to reduce false directional pressure signals, targeting the payoff weakness of the parent.

-(((high-prev_close)*volume - (prev_close-low)*volume).(20).ts_sum() / volume.(20).ts_sum(), gated by ts_adx(50) > 25 (full) vs *0.5, then 10-day EMA)

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(((high-prev_close)*volume - (prev_close-low)*volume).<rolling>(20).ts_sum() / volume.<rolling>(20).ts_sum(), gated by ts_adx(50) > 25 (full) vs *0.5, then 10-day EMA)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(where((ADX(AdjHigh, AdjLow, AdjClose, 50) > 25), ⊗1, multiply(⊗1, 0.5)), 10)
  2. 2. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ADX(AdjHigh, AdjLow, AdjClose, 50) > 25), ⊗1, multiply(⊗1, 0.5))
  3. 3. ADX —— 趋向指标
    ADX(AdjHigh, AdjLow, AdjClose, 50)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(⊗1, 0.5)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ADX平均趋向指数（趋势强度指标）
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 prev_close：close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 buy：(high - prev_close) * volume
  3. 计算 sell：(prev_close - low) * volume
  4. 计算 window：20
  5. 计算 net：(buy.rolling(window).sum() - sell.rolling(window).sum()) / volume.rolling(window).sum()
  6. 计算 adx：pd.Series(talib.ADX(high, low, close, timeperiod=50), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 factor：np.where(adx > 25, net, net * 0.5)
  8. 计算 factor：pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=10).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

  2. sum() — sum(x, n) → 滚动求和
  3. rolling(20) — rolling(n) → 滚动窗口
  4. sum() — sum(x, n) → 滚动求和

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_directional_imbalance_trend_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() prev_close = df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1) buy = (df_copy["str">'high'] - prev_close) * df_copy["str">'volume'] sell = (prev_close - df_copy["str">'low']) * df_copy["str">'volume'] window = 20 net = (buy.rolling(window).sum() - sell.rolling(window).sum()) / df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(window).sum().replace(0, np.nan) adx = pd.Series(talib.ADX(df_copy["str">'high'], df_copy["str">'low'], df_copy["str">'close'], timeperiod=50), index=df_copy.index) factor = np.where(adx > 25, net, net * 0.5) factor = pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=10).mean() factor.name = "factor_directional_imbalance_trend_gated" "kw">class="kw">return factor
